- Live walkthrough of a canary rollout and fallback policy
- Q&A with runtime engineers (limited seats)

Logistics
- Date: Tue, May 27 — 11:00am PT (90 min)
- Format: remote, hands-on (participants will run short exercises)
- Registration: https://app.redwood.in/events/register?evt=devlab-may27&utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=devlab-cloudwave (this is the primary RSVP link)

Can you share whether you and 1–2 engineers can join? If yes I’ll reserve seats and send the calendar invite. I’ve attached a one-page agenda and a short SSO integration note.

- If you want a pre-call to cover your infra/use-case, let me know preferred days

Thanks — we’ll keep this tight and technical.
